verdicts.reason: A is broken. The CTA pill is at the very top, above the quote, so the reading order is reversed. The quote mark floats with a dead gap above a small one-line headline. The blush circle has come apart from the bottle and sits alone in the bottom-right corner, and the small bottle floats in empty space. B keeps a strong hierarchy: a large wrapped quote, and the bottle layered on the circle as in the original. Its flaws are a large empty gap between the quote mark and the headline, attribution and CTA crammed onto one row, the CTA pill pressing against the circle and bottle edge, and the bottle sitting off-centre on its circle.
